svg.title: The 21 stacks, grouped by concern
svg.desc: Foundation: user-core, code-core. Language stacks: code-python, code-typescript, code-go, code-java, code-rust, code-csharp, code-mobile. Architecture and infrastructure: architect-devops, architect-dataops, architect-mlops, architect-cloud. Quality gates: security-core, test-core. Design and planning: design-frontend, plan-core, plan-docs. Agents and business: ai-agents, ai-tooling, business-core.
